integrity: Analytic moment and Schur proofs; smooth full-support counterexamples by perturbation; supplementary finite numerical checker is not a universal proof. No independent mathematical audit or external validation.
scientific_limitations: Index (1,1), two rotated even angular probability measures on strictly separated equal-width arcs, angular half-width below pi/2; not a statement about arbitrary measures, higher index, or Laurent multiple orthogonality.
source_ids: Minguez Ceniceros–Van Assche (2008), Multiple Orthogonal Polynomials on the Unit Circle
title: A sharp arc-width boundary for quadratic multiple orthogonal polynomial zeros
